material_effect_targets.rationale: 0.05 mean paired Brier reduction is the smallest effect that would justify Paper III's additional structural-witness layer as more than noise under the registered paired bootstrap/sign-flip gate (alpha=0.05). Smaller effects remain scientifically interesting but are treated as exploratory under a power-limited packet.

primary_definition: For each item i, brier_control_i - brier_structural_i with brier=(p-label)^2. Positive means structural witness reduces Brier relative to the strongest admissible non-structural control.
